task: Open /home/user/Documents/illustration.kra in Krita. It contains four paint layers named 'Sky', 'Mountains', 'Trees', and 'Character'. Group 'Sky' and 'Mountains' into a new group layer named 'Background_Elements'. Group 'Trees' and 'Character' into a new group layer named 'Foreground_Elements'. Reorder the two groups so that 'Foreground_Elements' sits above 'Background_Elements' in the layer stack. Do not delete or rename any of the four original paint layers. Save the file in place at /home/user/Documents/illustration.kra.
